title: Triangulate clues before commitment
description: Independent signals narrow a hypothesis; they still do not prove that customers will pay.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Use search, actual use and buyer discussion to choose a test. Count reused viral content as one clue, not three.
clothing: Compare original quiet motifs using wearer interviews, relevant store offers and observed everyday wardrobes.
physical: For a compact desk organiser, compare actual messy setups, existing prices and complaint patterns.
ai_commerce: Keep shopper requests, accessible product facts and observed answer inclusion separate.
saas: Check a merchant's repeated catalogue errors, native tools and paid workarounds before choosing a feature.
question: Which independent observation would kill this idea?
test: Record three independent clues and one plausible contradiction for each of three candidates; buy a sample only after identifying the unresolved purchase question.
trap: Treating a trend chart, reposts and a creator's video about that chart as independent demand evidence.

title: Translate identity into observable choices
description: An identity proposition becomes useful when a buyer can recognize it in the product and decide when to use it.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Specify a buyer's desired use and tradeoffs instead of assuming that wealth or fandom guarantees a premium purchase.
clothing: Test whether a charcoal crew feels suitable for ordinary outings to adults who want subtle fantasy references.
physical: Choose between discreet home utility and expressive desk decoration through observed settings.
ai_commerce: Describe the product's actual style and use so a buyer can compare it against a request.
saas: Target the operator who owns repeated data mistakes and needs a clear action list.
question: What would this person refuse to wear, use or buy?
test: Show two plainly labelled concepts to five relevant people; ask where each fits, what they dislike and which alternative they currently use.
trap: Inventing a buyer persona that simply restates the founder's own taste.

title: Translate a promise into production constraints
description: A visual concept is an incomplete product brief until it specifies how the promise survives manufacturing.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Convert the desired impression into supplier-readable constraints and acceptance checks before polishing mockups.
clothing: Specify actual thread colours, design size, placement and readable detail for the two/three-colour embroidery.
physical: Specify dimensions, load, contact surfaces and included components for a small organiser.
ai_commerce: Keep the accepted production facts consistent across page, markup and feed.
saas: Make each diagnostic rule state its input, supported platform, expected output and failure case.
question: Which production detail could destroy the apparent benefit?
test: Write a one-page specification; have the supplier flag unsuitable details; inspect the sample against the same checklist.
trap: Mistaking a convincing render or supplier's generic quality assurance for an accepted finished product.

title: Inspect the object before writing its story
description: Personal handling supplies failure evidence that product clips and supplier claims can conceal.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Use the sample to choose truthful demonstrations and expose reasons to abandon the product.
clothing: Measure, wear and wash the actual crew before claims about fit, softness or durable embroidery.
physical: Try the organiser in a realistic setup; inspect instability, awkward reach and unwanted marks.
ai_commerce: Photograph and record only attributes confirmed on the offered variant.
saas: Run a manual audit on permitted real merchant data before promising automated detection.
question: What did the physical or working sample change your mind about?
test: Record three promised uses and attempt each; reject any unsupported central benefit before production or marketing spend.
trap: Calling an unboxing a quality test.

title: Ask whether the benefit can be demonstrated
description: A demonstration should help a buyer inspect the relevant change, not merely create a watchable transformation.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Choose evidence visible in ordinary conditions and show the limitations along with the successful use.
clothing: Show scale, stitching and a real wearer rather than a fictional garment transformation.
physical: Show the same desk before and after installation with an unchanged camera position.
ai_commerce: Add comparison images and exact dimensions that remain meaningful outside the video.
saas: Show a real price mismatch detected, corrected and checked again in a named environment.
question: Which part of the claimed benefit can the buyer independently inspect?
test: Ask five people to explain the benefit after a silent 15-second demonstration; revise if they describe an effect the product does not provide.
trap: A dramatic edit implying durability, compatibility or outcomes that were never tested.

title: Separate concept from execution
description: The reason to buy and the way it is filmed are separate uncertainties; varying both hides the lesson.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Test buyer reasons first with comparable simple executions, then improve the surviving reason's presentation.
clothing: Compare everyday subtlety with original fantasy artistry using the same real garment shots.
physical: Compare cleaner setup with easier access using the same organiser demonstration.
ai_commerce: Test which concrete product facts answer a request before experimenting with prose formats.
saas: Compare time saved with errors prevented using the same scoped manual report.
question: Did the message fail, or did the viewer fail to understand the presentation?
test: Run three distinct concepts with one common format; record comprehension and qualified intent, then make two executions of the strongest concept.
trap: Twenty hook rewrites of one unconvincing offer counted as twenty independent ideas.

title: Match proof to the purchase doubt
description: Different doubts need different evidence. An attractive person wearing something does not establish its durability.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Name the exact doubt and provide evidence capable of reducing it; keep sample tests separate from customer reviews.
clothing: Use measured fit and wash evidence for garment uncertainty; real buyer accounts only for actual ownership experience.
physical: Use a load or compatibility test for function and an actual user's experience for usability.
ai_commerce: Expose measured facts, test conditions and genuine review provenance.
saas: Offer a reproducible defect record for detection claims and a paying operator's renewal for ongoing value.
question: What precise doubt does this evidence answer?
test: Ask five prospects for their main unanswered objection, then add one matching proof item and ask whether the objection changed.
trap: Using generic testimonials, follower counts or borrowed celebrity images as universal reassurance.

title: Evidence must support the exact claim
description: A source supporting a broad mechanism does not automatically support the offered product, dose, material or outcome.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Audit the scope of any factual claim. Delete claims whose evidence stops before the buyer's actual situation.
clothing: A fabric certificate does not prove every decoration is skin-friendly or that the crew lasts years.
physical: A category study does not prove this device's safety, performance or compatibility.
ai_commerce: State the tested model, variant and condition instead of expanding a general claim in AI-written copy.
saas: A local benchmark supports only that harness; it cannot certify live assistant ranking or sales lift.
question: Does the evidence cover this exact object and promised outcome?
test: Create a claim-to-evidence table for the page; narrow or remove every claim without directly relevant support.
trap: Treating the presence of a study, authority or benchmark as permission for a stronger sales claim.

title: Attention is an upstream event
description: Watching is a different action from wanting this offer at its delivered price; audience quality changes the economics.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Check the next meaningful action before paying to revisit an audience. Consent, platform rules and attribution need separate checks.
clothing: A motif animation may attract artists without attracting buyers of a £72 crew.
physical: A satisfying organiser clip may attract viewers who already solved the problem cheaply.
ai_commerce: An answer mention supplies no evidence of a visit, kept order or contribution.
saas: A popular audit post supplies no evidence that operators will connect data or pay.
question: Who took a purchase-relevant action after watching?
test: Tag a simple product page and compare price-aware enquiries or kept orders from each concept; record unknown attribution honestly.
trap: Calling high completion rates a warm buying audience.

title: Use distribution to extend a useful test
description: Cheap organic reach can screen presentation, but paid distribution introduces a different audience and a real acquisition cost.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Buy a bounded additional observation only when the offer and measurement can answer it; include production time in the cost.
clothing: Try a strong real-sample clip organically, then consider a capped test against the crew's after-labor contribution.
physical: Test one useful demonstration before paying to scale views of a generic product.
ai_commerce: Improve factual eligibility first; paid shopping performance does not prove organic AI inclusion.
saas: Test a scoped audit offer manually before a recurring promotion budget.
question: What uncertainty will the next pound resolve?
test: Write a spend ceiling, target buyer, meaningful event and stop rule before any future ad test; no spend is authorized by this dossier.
trap: Taking a viral post as permission for unlimited acquisition.

title: Diagnose the current constraint
description: A tactic that helped a large brand may target a constraint the small business does not yet have.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Find the first broken step in this business before borrowing a founder audience, celebrity endorsement or retention programme.
clothing: First resolve whether the sample and price fit the buyer; loyalty tools cannot repair that uncertainty.
physical: Resolve function and delivered economics before multiplying creator placements.
ai_commerce: Fix blocked pages or contradictory variant facts before buying a visibility dashboard.
saas: Resolve a repeated payable workflow before designing a referral programme.
question: Which necessary step currently has the weakest evidence?
test: Draw five steps from discovery to retained contribution; attach observations to each and fund only the earliest material uncertainty.
trap: Copying a case study's visible tactic while ignoring its capital, audience, category and stage.

title: Make the alternative explicit
description: A narrow reason to choose is easier to test when the buyer can compare it with what they currently do.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Name the substitute and a verifiable tradeoff without inventing an enemy or unsupported superiority.
clothing: Compare original restrained art with louder licensed-style graphic apparel through actual product attributes.
physical: Compare one organiser with an improvised cable tie or drawer rather than all desk products.
ai_commerce: Explain measured compatibility, total cost and limitations beside the obvious competing option.
saas: Compare a scoped mismatch report with native diagnostics and manual spreadsheet work.
question: What existing solution would the buyer give up?
test: Ask five prospects to show their current substitute, then make one truthful comparison addressing the largest remaining dissatisfaction.
trap: A challenger identity built from insults or comparisons the product cannot substantiate.

title: Keep the promise intact across the journey
description: A visitor should find the same specific offer after the click; every mismatch creates a new explanation burden.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Audit the promise as it moves between creative, page, checkout and fulfillment.
clothing: A video about subtle embroidered artwork must land on that real crew and its delivered price.
physical: An ad showing a two-part organiser must lead to the same pack quantity and dimensions.
ai_commerce: Ensure the selected variant, price, stock and policy agree across feed and page.
saas: Keep the audit demo, plan limits and delivered report aligned.
question: Where does a buyer's expectation first diverge from reality?
test: Have a fresh reviewer follow one journey and write expected versus actual product, cost, timing and result at each step.
trap: Improving each asset separately while allowing them to promise different things.

title: Give each page one decision job
description: A homepage can orient an unfamiliar visitor; an intent-specific page can answer a focused purchase question.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Choose the next useful decision for the visitor before adding sections or tools.
clothing: Use the homepage to explain the original quiet-fantasy brand; use the crew page for real fit, price and delivery evidence.
physical: Let a compatibility query land on the relevant model and exclusions.
ai_commerce: Expose a stable product URL with complete facts rather than hiding decisions in navigation.
saas: Let an operator evaluate the specific catalogue audit, scope and sample output.
question: What should this visitor be able to decide after this page?
test: Run a five-person task walkthrough; record whether each can identify product, suitability, total cost and next action without assistance.
trap: A beautiful homepage asked to answer every campaign, support and checkout question.

title: Order evidence by unresolved objections
description: More content is useful only when it answers the next doubt blocking a decision.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Collect actual confusion before writing FAQs, emails or a long sales page. Resolve the highest-risk doubt first.
clothing: Place garment measurements and real embroidery close-ups ahead of vague brand philosophy when fit and quality are the concerns.
physical: Explain exact compatibility before describing the founder's design journey.
ai_commerce: Put included parts, material and exclusions in readable product text.
saas: Explain access needs, supported channels and report limits before a long AI narrative.
question: What is the visitor still unable to determine?
test: Ask five people to attempt a purchase decision and speak their doubts; rewrite the first three unresolved answers, then repeat.
trap: Adding an FAQ full of questions that customers never asked.

title: Model the whole delivered offer
description: Discounts, bonuses and bundles change both what the buyer gets and what the business keeps.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Count every cost and define the buyer's actual receipt before testing any offer mechanic.
clothing: Compare a £72 delivered crew with a bundle only after costs, fees, return scenarios and labor are included.
physical: Compare one organiser and a multi-pack against true handling, shipping and replacement costs.
ai_commerce: Keep displayed prices and shipping policies consistent with the actual charge.
saas: Compare a £49 scoped plan with included checks, support minutes and retries costed.
question: What contribution remains if the buyer takes every included benefit?
test: Build an offer ledger for two candidates; stress-test refunds and cost overruns; reject any candidate with non-positive contribution before acquisition.
trap: Judging a free gift or discount by revenue while ignoring its delivery and support burden.

title: Set acquisition limits from retained contribution
description: The maximum affordable acquisition cost is a constraint, not a target and not proof of conversion.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Leave a deliberate allowance for fixed costs and profit; calculate using kept customers and all acquisition inputs.
clothing: Use the current modeled £26.03 crew after-labor contribution only as a scenario ceiling, then reserve room below it.
physical: A cheaper item may have less acquisition room despite lower purchase friction.
ai_commerce: A paid channel sale must meet its own margin test regardless of AI visibility.
saas: Include sales calls, onboarding and support when estimating the first paid account's contribution.
question: How much can acquisition cost before this retained order loses money?
test: Calculate break-even and chosen target CAC separately; record gifts, commissions, content rights and spend in the same ledger.
trap: Using headline ROAS or a rival's CAC as the store's own affordability rule.

title: Wait for costs that arrive later
description: An early sale can look profitable before its refund, replacement or support workload becomes visible.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Keep provisional and mature contribution separate; choose a maturity window appropriate to the product and policy.
clothing: Revisit each order after the applicable cancellation and return period, including replacements.
physical: Separate defect returns from changed-mind returns to identify different fixes.
ai_commerce: A channel-reported purchase remains provisional until merchant settlement and return reconciliation.
saas: Measure renewal and support by join month instead of projecting lifetime value from one payment.
question: Which costs have not had time to appear?
test: Maintain cohort rows with receipt, fulfillment, fees, refunds, labor and acquisition; mark unfinished windows explicitly.
trap: Scaling from launch-week revenue while later losses remain unobserved.

title: Profit and available cash use different clocks
description: Positive unit contribution cannot pay an invoice before the payout arrives.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Model payment timing and the worst affordable short gap separately from expected margin.
clothing: Reserve cash for supplier orders and refunds during payout delays.
physical: Check inventory deposits and replacement shipment timing before accepting a larger batch.
ai_commerce: Reconcile channel order exports, fees and settlement timing when checkout occurs elsewhere.
saas: Annual receipts can hide months of continuing service obligations; earmark the cost to deliver them.
question: What payment comes due before the corresponding money is usable?
test: Make a dated cash schedule for a small order burst and one refund scenario; cap volume at the reserve actually available.
trap: Spending gross receipts because the contribution spreadsheet is positive.

title: Separate first purchase from repeat purchase
description: Existing buyers and new buyers answer different questions about acquisition and business durability.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Use customer-level records where permitted and keep uncertain identity matches unknown.
clothing: A returning supporter buying the second motif does not establish profitable cold acquisition.
physical: A replacement or extra pack is different from a first customer's initial order.
ai_commerce: Track channel-assisted orders without assuming every cited product creates a new customer.
saas: Separate first paid activation, renewal and expansion in the account ledger.
question: Did this tactic acquire a customer or monetize someone already acquired?
test: Report new kept customers, repeat kept orders and contribution separately for each experiment window.
trap: Letting existing-customer revenue make an unprofitable new-customer campaign look successful.

title: Fit retention to the natural use cycle
description: Repeat buying depends on the product's real replacement or continuing-service need; it should not be assumed from another category.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Estimate why and when a buyer would need another purchase before building subscriptions, email volume or projected LTV.
clothing: A durable crew needs a new compelling design or a different occasion; assume no replenishment until observed.
physical: A lasting organiser may be a one-off sale; expansion packs need a distinct use.
ai_commerce: A helpful discovery channel does not create repeat need for the product it recommends.
saas: A catalogue changes repeatedly; test whether new defects and time saved justify another paid audit.
question: What recurring event would make buying again sensible?
test: Map the actual use cycle with five users; test a second paid task or purchase only when that need occurs.
trap: Borrowing consumable subscription economics for clothing, durable goods or a one-time software report.

title: Repair the research brief before generating more
description: AI output cannot supply missing customer evidence by producing more fluent variations.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Require an observed problem, a concrete offer, available proof and a forbidden-claims list in each creative brief.
clothing: Supply actual wearer comments, sample facts and the artwork's intent before asking for hooks.
physical: Supply recorded setup friction and a verified demonstration.
ai_commerce: Give the model a controlled product record and original source links.
saas: Use permitted merchant examples and measured audit effort when drafting an offer.
question: Which sentence in the brief depends on an unverified assumption?
test: Write one brief by hand, mark uncertain inputs, then use AI for three different buyer reasons; reject any draft that invents facts.
trap: Asking a model to discover an audience and then treating its invented audience as research.

title: Translate features into a buyer consequence
description: A feature matters commercially only if the intended buyer understands what it lets them do or avoid.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Connect each true feature to a specific use, then ask the buyer whether that consequence matters enough to affect choice.
clothing: Explain a restrained motif through everyday outfit use; test whether the wearer actually values that freedom.
physical: Connect dimensions to the user's available desk space and reach.
ai_commerce: State compatibility, included parts and total delivered cost in decision language.
saas: Connect mismatch detection to fewer manual checks or preventable price errors.
question: What changes for this buyer because this feature exists?
test: For five important features, write one consequence and ask prospects to rank its importance against price and their current alternative.
trap: Inflating every feature into an emotional transformation the buyer never requested.

title: Spend on distinct questions before cosmetic variants
description: Creative variety is useful when it probes different buyer reasons; more assets alone can exceed the business's capacity to learn.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Treat agency production volumes as unsuitable defaults. Buy the smallest set of assets that separates meaningful hypotheses.
clothing: Test subtle daily wear, visible craft and original lore as different reasons before producing twenty similar edits.
physical: Test reduced clutter and easier access separately.
ai_commerce: Test dimensions, compatibility and price completeness as distinct information defects.
saas: Test operator time saved and error recovery as separate paid jobs.
question: How many different uncertainties does this asset set actually test?
test: Give each asset a unique hypothesis and planned observation; remove assets that ask the same question without enough traffic to compare execution.
trap: Calling slight crop, music or opening-word changes an evidence-backed creative strategy.

title: Use service to help and diagnose
description: Post-purchase communication can improve correct use and reveal which promises did not survive delivery.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Design a small, useful service sequence and log defects; referral effects remain hypotheses until measured.
clothing: Send accurate care instructions and delivery updates; ask about fit and embroidery after real use.
physical: Explain setup and limits, then ask about wobble, compatibility or damage.
ai_commerce: Make fulfillment facts match channel claims and trace stale information complaints.
saas: Deliver a fix list, verify the merchant's correction and ask what remains hard.
question: What must the buyer know to receive the promised value?
test: Use one confirmation, needed delivery notices and one timed feedback request; record contacts, corrections and resolved problems.
trap: Copying a supplement brand's repeated email cadence or requesting praise before the customer can judge the item.

title: Prefer contribution per visitor to conversion alone
description: A page can produce more orders while leaving less money after discounts and delivery costs.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Use revenue per visitor as an intermediate measure, then account for retained contribution and uncertainty.
clothing: A discount that raises crew conversion can still reduce kept contribution per visitor.
physical: A bundle can raise basket value while increasing shipping or returns.
ai_commerce: A citation or click must eventually be connected to retained merchant value before a commercial claim.
saas: A higher free-to-paid rate can coexist with costly support and lower contribution per account.
question: Did the page change leave more retained contribution for the same opportunity?
test: Compare full-price and proposed offers using costed scenarios first; in a later valid test record visitors, kept orders, contribution and confidence limits.
trap: Selecting a conversion winner because its acquisition and fulfillment costs are on a different dashboard.

title: Keep AI conclusions attached to source facts
description: AI-assisted research becomes reviewable when another person can recover the input fact, date and uncertainty.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: Store source-level evidence and check important outputs against it; a model's confidence is not verification.
clothing: Trace fibre, production and care claims to the selected SKU and sample.
physical: Verify supplier identity, dimensions and safety evidence independently of a generated product shortlist.
ai_commerce: Maintain the exact source for every page/feed fact and log corrections.
saas: Return source URL, observed field, rule, timestamp and suggested action in each diagnostic.
question: Can a reviewer reproduce this conclusion from its cited inputs?
test: Manually audit ten generated statements; fail the workflow on any unsupported material claim and repair the source handling before automation.
trap: A polished AI analysis silently mixing a fake demo, obsolete source and live merchant facts.

title: Write the next stop decision before spending
description: A test needs a result that can end the idea, not only a reason to keep improving it.
evidence_status: transcript-reviewed creator teaching; applications, thresholds and tests are analyst hypotheses
our_adaptation: This stop rule is our adaptation: specify what success, failure and inconclusive evidence permit, including a maximum cash and time loss.
clothing: Stop a sample path if the stitch test fails or buyers reject both tested prices; diagnose one material issue before repeating.
physical: Stop if useful function or safe economics depend on unsupported attributes.
ai_commerce: Stop speculative ranking work when the observable outcome is only eligibility or unstable mentions.
saas: Stop a pilot if support exceeds its contribution or the merchant declines a second useful paid task.
question: What result would make further work a bad use of the next pound?
test: Before a test write its decision, cost ceiling, deadline and one allowed revision; log inconclusive separately and spend again only for a named unresolved question.
trap: Reframing every failure as an invitation to add features, variants, content or traffic.
